name: mutual-nda-composer
title: Mutual NDA Composer
description: Assembles a Common Paper Mutual NDA from Cover Page Key Terms, then binds a party's acceptance to the assembled artifact by its execution_hash, template_id, and vendored body_sha256.

steps.handoff: assembled_markdown and contract_api (template_id, body_sha256, variable_map) feed the acceptance binder as the referenced artifact
accepted_template_id, accepted_body_sha256, and referenced_execution_hash form the countersignable acceptance record
